messages.subject: rendering shiny app on mobile
parts:
Hi,

I'm fairly new to shiny and am using it to develop a new app for my organisation - basically a bespoke search tool - and am making heavy use of DT within it  - see app here https://benc-shiny.shinyapps.io/shiny-bca-home_-_tabbed_version/

Anyway, I've got it working ok on a PC but am having a few issues getting it to render nicely on a mobile.

As you'll see I end up with a very long data table with a very thin search result column.

Any advice for how I can improve this layout? I've tried using the 'responsive' extension in DT but it didn't really improve it much. Perhaps I need something to detect that the app is being accessed by a mobile and supress some of the other columns in the table automatically?

Thanks in advance.
Ben
